item.title: Animal Collective Score First Gold Record
item.description: "My Girls" has always felt like Animal Collective's biggest hit. Critics loved it; it was Pitchfork's pick for the #1 song of 2009 and finished at #3 on that year's Pazz & Jop critics poll, among other accolades. It was the most accessible song on AnCo's most accessible album, Merriweather Post Pavilion. I even got away with playing it at house parties in my twenties, at the peak of Kanye, Katy, and Skrillex. The post Animal Collective Score First Gold Record appeared first on Stereogum.
